decks.notes: The deck focuses on casting disruptive spells like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon to shut down opponents' lands, while using fast mana sources like Ancient Tomb and Chrome Mox. It also aims to quickly ramp into powerful Dragon creatures like Pyrogoyf and Fury, applying pressure on the opponent. The deck is designed to be proactive and aggressive, leveraging its disruptive elements to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. It also incorporates artifact support cards like The One Ring and Vexing Bauble to enhance its strategy.

This Dimir Tempo deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining pressure through efficient creatures and countermagic spells. The key strategy involves quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, while using disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to control the opponent's actions. By utilizing cards like Fatal Push and Nihil Spellbomb to remove threats and disrupt graveyard strategies, the deck can quickly close out games by outmaneuvering the opponent and maintaining tempo advantage.

This Dimir Tempo deck focuses on playing disruptive spells like Daze, Thoughtseize, and Force of Will to control the opponent's resources while deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck also includes cards like Fatal Push and Nihil Spellbomb to handle opposing threats, with Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student providing card advantage and Brazen Borrower offering flexibility. The strategy is to efficiently disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a proactive game plan of its own to secure victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while efficiently deploying threats to control the pace of the game. By utilizing a mix of hand disruption, removal spells, and counterspells, the deck aims to keep the opponent off-balance and unable to execute their game plan. Murktide Regent provides a powerful finisher while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps with card advantage and filtering. The deck also includes cards like Wasteland and Stifle to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while controlling the game state.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards such as Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's plays, combined with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to maintain tempo advantage. Additionally, utilizing powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower, as well as card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Brainstorm, allows the deck to close out games quickly and efficiently.

This deck revolves around utilizing Mystic Forge to continuously cast artifacts from the top of the library, generating card advantage and enabling powerful combos. It aims to assemble a strong board presence using artifacts like Glaring Fleshraker and The One Ring, while also disrupting opponents with cards like Pithing Needle. The deck includes various mana acceleration tools like Lotus Petal and Urza's Workshop to quickly reach its combo pieces. Karn, the Great Creator grants access to silver bullet sideboard options, while Voltaic Key and Grim Monolith provide additional ways to generate mana for explosive plays.

The main concept of this Dimir Tempo deck is to control the tempo of the game by using disruptive spells like Force of Will, Thoughtseize, and Daze while also deploying aggressive threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf to pressure the opponent. The deck aims to efficiently disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with its creatures to close out the game quickly. This balance of disruption and aggression allows the deck to maintain control of the game and dictate the pace of play, leading to a strategic advantage over the opponent.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Nomads en-Kor and Springheart Nantuko to create a loop of creature untaps and damage triggers. Nadu, Winged Wisdom acts as the key piece to draw through the deck and find the combo pieces needed to win the game. The deck also includes various green mana accelerants like Noble Hierarch and Gaea's Cradle to ramp into the combo quickly. Leovold, Emissary of Trest and other disruptive creatures like Collector Ouphe are included to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect the combo.

This deck aims to quickly cheat out powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. It utilizes efficient card draw and counterspells to protect its combo pieces, with the potential to cast multiple spells in a single turn. The deck also includes alternate win conditions like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and The One Ring to provide flexibility in how it can close out the game. By carefully managing resources and timing, the pilot can overwhelm opponents with high-impact threats before they can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on using Nadu, Winged Wisdom as the key combo piece to generate card advantage and control the board. It utilizes Green Sun's Zenith to search for Nadu and protect it with counterspells like Force of Will. The deck also includes cards like Prismatic Ending and Swords to Plowshares for removal, as well as cards like Teferi, Time Raveler for additional control. The mana base includes fetch lands and dual lands for consistency, and the inclusion of cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath provide additional value to stay ahead in the game.

Utilize disruptive spells and evasive creatures to control the board and apply pressure to opponents quickly in order to outpace them and secure victory. The deck focuses on tempo plays, utilizing cards like Daze and Force of Will to counter opponents' spells while deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower to close out the game. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Psychic Frog provide card advantage and filtering, while Fatal Push and Thoughtseize help deal with opposing threats. Wasteland and other land disruption cards are included to disrupt opponents' mana bases and slow them down.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo strategy of reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game to overwhelm the opponent. It includes a variety of control cards like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through blinking creatures like Psychic Frog and Brazen Borrower for extra card advantage and tempo advantage. The deck also includes ways to tutor for combo pieces with cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize to set up explosive plays.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, such as Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand, using cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Entomb. It also incorporates disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Show and Tell can be used to cheat out big threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Valgavoth, Terror Eater. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruption to secure a victory.

The main concept of this control Stiflenought deck is to use counterspells, removals, and disruptive cards like Stifle and Dress Down to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to stall the game with cards like Phyrexian Dreadnought while setting up powerful interactions like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Doorkeeper Thrull. The deck also utilizes efficient card draw with Brainstorm and Ponder to find key pieces and maintain resources. The aim is to establish dominance through control and powerful synergies to outmaneuver the opponent in the Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on cheating powerful creatures onto the battlefield quickly through cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with huge threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand, making it difficult for them to recover. The deck also includes cards like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect your combo pieces, as well as card draw and mana acceleration to help you execute your game plan efficiently. The combination of explosive plays and control elements makes this deck a formidable force in the Legacy format.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the entire deck, then using Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle for an instant win. The deck has a lot of card selection with Ponder, Brainstorm, and Once Upon a Time, as well as disruption with Force of Will and Daze. Teferi, Time Raveler is used to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent, while Nadu, Winged Wisdom can also be used as an alternate win condition. The deck aims to quickly and efficiently combo off before the opponent can respond.
